set.approach: The roof crack is on the slope a short way above the bathroom at the Fairy Meadows camp, and it is easy to find. Mount Harrison Smith fills the skyline behind it. The crags here are short and the walk from camp is brief.
set.descent_text: The route ends at a gear anchor on top, and the way down is a walk-off.

review.notes: Route page gives the start (just above the bathroom) and gear anchor with walk-off; area page gives the cragging context.

set.approach: The Phoenix is the northeast face of the Sundial massif, also called Mount Dracula. From the lake, rough ground with little elevation gain leads to a good basecamp, and the base of the wall is a further walk across the same broken terrain. The Phreenix climbs the prominent face, which several other crack-system lines also climb, some with aid, stopping at different heights.

review.notes: Approach from the area page (lake, basecamp, rough terrain) and route location; descent not stated as a route, so approach only.
